SELECT SEQ_MEMBER_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MEMBER_NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_SEQ, RECEIVER_SEQ, SENDER_SEQ, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, REFERENCE_SEQ, NOTIFICATION_CONTENT, READ_YN ) VALUES ( #{notification_seq}, #{receiver_seq}, #{sender_seq}, #{notification_type}, #{reference_seq}, #{notification_content}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTIFICATION_SEQ, N.RECEIVER_SEQ, N.SENDER_SEQ, N.NOTIFICATION_TYPE, N.REFERENCE_SEQ, N.NOTIFICATION_CONTENT, N.READ_YN, NVL( (SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = N.SENDER_SEQ), (SELECT M.NICKNAME FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.MEMBER_SEQ = N.SENDER_SEQ) ) AS SENDER_NICK, CI.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AS CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, CR.ROOM_NAME AS ROOM_NAME FROM MEMBER_NOTIFICATION N LEFT JOIN CHAT_INVITATION CI ON N.NOTIFICATION_TYPE = 'CHAT_INVITE' AND CI.CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ = N.REFERENCE_SEQ LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM CR ON CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CI.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ WHERE N.RECEIVER_SEQ = #{value} ORDER BY N.NOTIFICATION_SEQ DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_SEQ = #{value} AND READ_YN = 'N'
